messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — Lagoon onboarding: saw repeat 99p tail spikes during batch ingest test. Proactive rec: try int8 quant + swap to small model variant for high-concurrency paths, and prefer dedicated pool routing during peak. Can we run a quick canary?

ops-bot: ingest-qps=120, seq_len=1024, 99p_latency=3.9s (baseline 1.6s), kv_cache_miss=28% — flagging tail latency cluster.

Raj (Eng-ML): I can spin up a perf bench with a quantized checkpoint. Quick estimate: int8 should save ~25-35% token cost and reduce tail by ~10-20% on our A100 nodes depending on batch shape. Need the onboarding prompt set to run fidelity checks.

Linh (Solutions): Proposed rollout: 1) create alias `lagoon-int8-canary` -> quantized-small; 2) routing policy: prefer `dedicated-pool-west` with fallback to `hosted-small` after 50ms queue threshold; 3) enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompts. Start canary at 10% traffic for 2 hours, monitor quality metrics.

Alex (AE): Customer will want quality guardrails. Can we produce a diff report on their sample evals (precision / hallucination checks)? I can schedule a short enablement call.

Maya (CSM): I'll compile a 150-sample eval set from their onboarding traffic and drop in the shared drive by EOD. Suggest a 30-min sync with Lagoon to walk the rollback plan and SLA expectations. Target: Weds EOD for canary roll.

Raj (Eng-ML): Benchmark command and canary config (local):
```bash
# quantize checkpoint and run perf bench
python tools/quantize.py --input model.ckpt --output model-int8.ckpt --bits 8
python tools/bench.py --model model-int8.ckpt --seq-len 1024 --batch 8 --iters 200
```
Routing snippet (yaml):
```yaml
route_policy:
  - match: "/ingest/*"
    prefer: dedicated-pool-west
    fallback: hosted-small
    fallback_threshold_ms: 50
    canary_alias: lagoon-int8-canary
    canary_traffic: 0.10
```

Linh (Solutions): I'll draft the rollout doc + rollback playbook. Rollback trigger idea: any quality regression >1.5% on acceptance evals or user-visible 99p latency worse than baseline by >20%. Also adding trace hooks and sample diff alerts. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Canary `lagoon-int8-canary` deployed to dedicated-pool-west (10% traffic). Health checks passing.

Alex (AE): I'll schedule the enablement slot and include the diff report. Adding a note to the renewal health tracker that we're proactively addressing latency and cost.

Maya (CSM): Great — thanks team. Will post the eval set and ping once the customer call is booked. :rocket:
